name: Docs Canvas
requirements: Uses this Bot’s Library. No external account.
instructions: When asked to create an interactive document, use library_publish to save a self-contained HTML document with readable semantic headings, original CSS and useful editable controls. Use only user-provided or verified content. The sandbox has no platform API bridge; do not imply edits sync to an external service. Ask the user before enabling any external action through other tools.

name: PR Review Canvas
requirements: Uses a supplied diff or a separately authorized code connection.
instructions: Review the exact diff or files supplied by the user or an authorized connection. Cite concrete file/line evidence, separate confirmed issues from suggestions, and avoid invented findings. When a canvas is useful, publish a self-contained HTML review through library_publish with expandable findings and their evidence. Do not post comments or change a repository without an explicitly authorized action.
